items.raw_excerpt: The newspaper served as a bridge, connecting expatriates with Britain while keeping them informed about their adopted homeland
items.summary_en: The Buenos Aires Herald was founded 150 years ago. It was started by British people living in Argentina. The paper told expats about life in Argentina and told Argentina about life in Britain.

items.title_en: A Newspaper Turns 150 Years Old in Argentina
items.title_original: The Herald at 150: A British voice witnessing Argentine history

items.raw_excerpt: Mercadona continues to strengthen its presence in Portugal, this time with a new store in the north.

items.raw_excerpt: The Algarve may be better known for beaches and golf courses, but one of its natural treasures has just picked up recognition for something rather different.
